name: Evidence-Backed Talent Profile
problem: A person, team or representative wants a structured view of demonstrated capabilities, missing proof, development questions and plausible opportunity classes without opaque personality scoring or sensitive-trait inference.
intent_terms: evaluate this candidate from the evidence
build a talent profile from this portfolio
what roles fit this person's demonstrated skills
find gaps in this candidate's proof
turn this athlete or creator evidence into an opportunity dossier
map this person's capabilities to opportunities
inputs: Person/prospect identifier, domain and supplied/authorized evidence; optional target opportunity and consent grant for nonpublic material.
outputs: Strengths, weaknesses, patterns, skills, development questions, evidence confidence, inference limits, opportunity bridge and missing proof.
pricing: No approved machine price/payment path was verified. Do not auto-quote.
confirmation: No contact, representation, application or third-party sharing without explicit authority/consent. Analysis must not infer protected traits or use gated sensitive data for scoring.
payment_authority: No verified Evercraft Payments path for this capability.
invocation_status: LIVE: public machine discovery docs plus central Evercraft MCP matching. Commercial execution remains verification-gated; no automatic checkout or payment obligation.
